gates.title: D2 symbol identity + referenced-by trust fix
gates.depends: g1 -- the regression must be able to go red before it is fixed
gates.task: TWO defects on one line of code; the issue itself says the referenced-by fix 'ships with #2 -- same line'. (a) D2: astx.py:_func emits mod:{clsstack[-1]}.{name} whenever ANY class is on the stack, regardless of how deep inside a method the definition sits, so a closure inside Class.test_x is emitted as mod:Class.<closure> -- the METHOD name is dropped, not the class. Two same-named closures in two methods of one class collide and their caller sets union. A class defined inside a function is separately named as if module-level. MEASURED: exactly 4 real collisions on this repo, listed in .agent-work/issue-456/reference/d2_collisions.txt (probe at reference/probe_d2.py simulates the extractor's actual rule). Write the failing test against those 4 named collisions FIRST. (b) Referenced-by: the name list omits the defining module while the count includes it, and nothing states that the count already excludes definition/import/docstring mentions -- so the map says 3 where grep says 7 and the reader cannot tell which is wrong.
gates.close: D2 HAS TWO ARMS and both must close (found by the plan panel, verified: reference/d2_arms.txt). ARM 1 -- closure inside a method, 31 occurrences here, 4 collisions: each of the 4 named collisions resolves to a distinct symbol that CARRIES THE METHOD NAME, asserted on the SYMBOL STRING not the collision count, red-then-green. ARM 2 -- class defined inside a function, which visit_ClassDef emits as mod:Name as if module-level because it has NO enclosing-chain branch at all: ZERO occurrences on this corpus, so it cannot go red here at any threshold and a PURPOSE-BUILT FIXTURE is the only route, exactly like BOM. OVER-QUALIFICATION GUARD: the 75 naive mod.name clashes are correctly distinct today, so sibling-class setUp must keep mod:Class.setUp and gain no spurious segment -- their disappearance is the alarm, not the goal, because a fix re-keying by file position would zero the collision count while corrupting 1,776 method symbols. AND count and module list agree on every page with the semantics stated. NOT SUFFICIENT: closing on '4 -> 0' ships arm 2 unwritten.
gates.command: python -m pytest tests/ -q  AND  python -m pytest tests/test_code_map.py -k 'symbol_identity or referenced_by' -q

TOMMY'S RULING, and it governs every threshold here: a tripwire must be USEFUL -- it must not send a future run down a rabbit hole or make it climb an unnecessary speed bump. Concretely: a threshold earns its place only if tripping it means something is actually WRONG. If a threshold would fire on ordinary healthy change (the corpus grew, a docstring was reworded, a page gained a line), it is a speed bump and must be dropped or widened rather than shipped and then routinely waived. Prefer few sharp tripwires over many twitchy ones. Every threshold committed here must state, in one line, what a human should DO when it fires -- a tripwire with no action is noise.
